scope: Full current directory exchange, retry/revert and local owning-document relocation plan tests
assessment: Actual native atomic directory exchange preserves both original directory identities and bytes and reports parent synchronization
Repeated apply/revert after injected fsync failure preserves operation direction; absent-root publication is retryable and reversible
Symlink, non-directory, overlapping roots and replaced directory identities refuse mutation; injected pre-native-call replacement preserves concurrent owner note
Local relocation plan binds owning local document hash; preparation preserves both configuration files and does not activate target
Git policy identifies exact local configuration and installation/restoration staging paths; byte snapshot unchanged after policy observation

verification.command: PYTHONPATH=tests:plugins/app-store-creative/scripts python3 -W error::ResourceWarning -m unittest test_directory_change_recovery test_directory_exchange test_configuration_local_relocation_plan -q

limitations: Same-filesystem disposable fixtures; no actual cross-volume, power loss or real product acceptance
Sync and native permission failures are injected; no independent permission-restricted identity
Plan preparation does not prove completed local configuration activation; covered separately
Identity replacement refusal assertions preserve selected files rather than a complete tree snapshot
